_how_to_edit: This one file controls every asset on the site. Edit it, commit, push: the site and the daily price job pick it up.
To ADD an income fund: copy one block in "income", change ticker/yahoo/name/color/dividend fields. Prices + dividend history are fetched automatically.
To REMOVE one: delete its block (and remove it from income_presets / portfolio.allocation if it's listed there).
To add a NON-income asset you can route payouts into (like IBIT or MSTR): add it to "growth".
annual_dividend: dollars per share per year, OR "ttm" to use the trailing-12-month payouts from the price data.
schedule: semimonthly | monthly | quarterly | daily. pay_day = day of month it pays (default 15). quarter_months = which months quarterly payers pay.
daily_proposed_from: only for funds that may switch to daily payouts. Used by the 'Daily (proposed)' toggle. Omit otherwise.
history_from: how far back to download prices (YYYY-MM-DD).
payout_presets: ready-made ways to split payouts. kind = same (buy more of the fund that paid) | buy (needs target ticker) | margin | bills | cash.
live_quotes_url: the free Cloudflare Worker (worker/ folder) that serves real-time prices for every ticker here. BTC is priced live in the browser.

income.name: Strategy Stretch Preferred
income.about: Variable-rate preferred stock from Strategy. Currently pays 12.00% a year on a $100 stated amount ($12/yr), twice a month ($0.50 each).

income.name: Strategy Strife Preferred
income.about: Fixed 10% on $100 ($10/yr), paid quarterly. Cumulative: skipped dividends are still owed. The most senior of Strategy's preferreds.

income.name: Strategy Strike Preferred
income.about: Fixed 8% on $100 ($8/yr), paid quarterly, cumulative. Convertible: 10 STRK can become 1 MSTR share.

income.name: Strategy Stride Preferred
income.about: Fixed 10% on $100 ($10/yr), paid quarterly. NON-cumulative: if Strategy skips a payment, it never has to make it up. Least senior.

income.name: NEOS Bitcoin High Income ETF
income.about: Covered-call ETF that sells options on bitcoin funds for monthly income. Recent distribution rate ~25–28% (last payout $0.7184 on Sept 30, 2026), mostly return of capital. 0.99% expense ratio. Upside is capped and the price can erode over time.

growth.name: iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF
growth.about: Spot bitcoin ETF from BlackRock. Tracks the bitcoin price, pays no dividend.

growth.name: Strategy common stock
growth.about: Strategy's common stock. Pays no dividend; moves with bitcoin and Strategy's own decisions.
